## Landed

- `exports/src/exports/search_query_v2.py` — `SearchEngineV2.export_records`: the served `sig.search-results/2` payload plus an `export` block enumerating up to `EXPORT_ROW_CAP` (10,000) record rows across the whole set — same match-quality order, the denial barrier per candidate BEFORE emission, collapsed acronym word-hits withheld, per-group exact `total` beside `exported`/`truncated`. Suggestion re-runs enumerate the corrected tokens.
- `exports/src/exports/search_export.py` (new) — `search_export_zip`: the deterministic `application/zip` bundle — one folder per licence group (`<comp>/results.csv` | `results.json` `sig.search-export-records/1`, `<comp>/LICENCE.txt`, `<comp>/ATTRIBUTION.txt`), `manifest.json` (`sig.search-export/1`), `README.txt`, `SHA256SUMS`. Never a mixed-compartment file; ADR-224 `#`-comment licence preamble on the CSV; per-row licence column; attribution names exported-row sources and points at the release's downloads for the captured terms verbatim (never re-typed). Fixed timestamps, sorted members, no clock values → byte-identical for an identical request.
- `api/src/api/release_search_v2.py` — `KNOWN_EXPORT_PARAMS_V2` (the search set minus `cursor`/`limit`), `EXPORT_FORMATS_V2`, `ReleaseSearchV2Store.search_export` (same resolve/withdrawal barrier/engine LRU as `search`), `render_search_export_v2`.
- `api/src/api/app.py` — `GET /v1/releases/{publication_id}/search/export` under the same `SIG_API_SEARCH_V2` posture block: `format` ∈ csv|json (422 otherwise), typed param refusals, `Content-Disposition` attachment, same cache contract (immutable pub-pinned / 300 latest), same HTML-or-JSON error surface.
- `exports/src/exports/search_results_page.py` — "Download these results" section on the T0 no-JS page: per-licence-group `collection=` CSV/JSON links + all-groups links, the ≤10,000-row and never-mixed statements.
- `tests/api/test_release_search_export.py` (new, 15 tests) + `tests/exports/test_search_export.py` (new, 8 tests) — zip shape, per-group licence files, SHA256SUMS verification, cap+truncation, denial barrier, withdrawal 410, param 422s, determinism, page-advertised links, CSV quoting, OpenAPI, posture-off 404.
- `CHANGELOG.md` — the P37.43 entry (api-route public-behaviour path).
